definitions.explanation: Describes something with considerable thickness or depth. The opposite of {薄|うす}い (thin). Used for books, walls, slices, etc. Different from {暑|あつ}い (hot weather) and {熱|あつ}い (hot to touch).

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{厚|あつ}いですね。
examples.english: This book is thick, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {厚|あつ}い{肉|にく}を{焼|や}きます。
{壁|かべ}が{厚|あつ}いので{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえません。
examples.english: The walls are thick so I can't hear any sound.

notes: Be careful not to confuse with the other あつい words: {暑|あつ}い (hot weather), {熱|あつ}い (hot to touch). The kanji {厚|あつ}い specifically means 'thick.' The opposite is {薄|うす}い (thin).
